subject: Trading
title: Hammer and Hanging Man
description: A quick, practical guide to Hammer and Hanging Man.

hook.text: Same shape, opposite meaning. A hammer at a bottom signals reversal up. A hanging man at a top warns of reversal down.

buildup.text: Both have a small body and a long lower wick—at least twice the body's length.

discovery.text: A hammer shows sellers pushed hard but buyers reclaimed ground. At a support level, that's bullish.

twist.text: The same candle near a peak is a hanging man—sellers nearly won, and the trend is tired.

climax.text: Context determines meaning. The same pattern can be bullish or bearish depending on where it appears.

quiz.question: What makes a hammer bullish while a hanging man is bearish?
options: Location—hammer at a bottom, hanging man at a top
